scientific_question: When provenance labels are missing or misassigned, do confluence-focused site observations retain information about activation history beyond complete occupancy snapshots, and how does their benefit change with survey coverage and classification error?

fixed_stochastic_world_design.prior_on_truth_histories: uniform 1/3 each independently within each design; no fitting to observed real genetic outcomes

provenance_assay.idealized_target: exact set of earliest source IDs reaching each non-source equilibrium-reachable node under one history; NOT genetic ancestry or admixture in nature
provenance_assay.static_site_class: number of equilibrium-graph source nodes that can reach a non-source node, ignoring activation order

policies.confluence_targeted: sort candidate nodes with >=2 potential graph sources by descending potential source-count then ascending node ID; choose first min(3,n) WITHOUT reading history-specific labels
policies.random_response_blind: choose first min(3,n) by deterministic SHA256 integer ranking of fixed seed, design key, node ID; NEVER use current or outcome provenance labels
policies.unique_origin_negative_control: sort nodes reached by exactly one potential source by node ID; choose first min(3,n)

provenance_assay.noise_likelihood: with probability 1-q report missing; otherwise report true label with (1-e), each other category with e/(K-1), where catalog is distinct true tag classes across 3 histories plus artificial UNSEEN category; independent across selected sites conditional on true history

estimands.occupancy_only_posterior: exact conditioning on four snapshots with uniform prior over three activation histories
estimands.noisy_provenance_posterior: Bayes conditioning on selected noisy/missing provenance reports using the KNOWN frozen synthetic likelihood
estimands.expected_conditional_mutual_information_: I(H; observed source-tag reports | exact four-snapshot occupancy) under uniform three-history truth prior
estimands.bayes_correct_history_accuracy_gain: unconditional expected gain in Bayes-optimal exact activation-history classification after provenance reports, relative to occupancy snapshots alone
estimands.occupancy_ambiguity_subset: design rows for which two or more of three histories have identical full occupancy snapshot signatures
estimands.equal_budget_confluence_comparison: restrict confluence vs random comparison to designs with >=3 static confluence nodes and >=3 non-source nodes; report both all-design and equal-budget eligible
estimands.outcome_simulation: exact finite enumeration of missing/categorical measurement outcomes, NOT Monte Carlo response draws

predeclared_hypotheses.rule: On occupancy-ambiguous designs with >=3 confluence sites, average confluence-policy information at q=1,e=0 is >0
For any q and e, unique-origin negative control adds 0 conditional mutual information and 0 Bayes classification gain
On equal-budget occupancy-ambiguous designs, mean conditional mutual information at q=0.60,e=0.10 is strictly higher for confluence-targeted than response-blind random site selection
For each observation policy, aggregate conditional information never increases when e grows from 0 to 0.10 to 0.25 at q=0.60, nor decreases when q grows 0.25 to 0.60 to 1 at e=0.10
On occupancy-ambiguous designs with confluence eligibility, mean confluence policy Bayes-correct-history gain at q=0.60,e=0.10 is strictly >0

negative_controls: zero coverage means zero information and zero classifier gain
static one-origin-site assays are history invariant
adding correctly modeled evidence cannot decrease expected Bayes accuracy
parent v23 occupancy information baseline unchanged
